name: Niidori Mao
source:
The widow who became a housemate at the Miyakura household.

Originally living alone in a house across from the Miyakura's, she accidentally started a small fire due to carelessness and ended up staying with the Miyakura's while repairs were made.

She's serious but impatient. A troublemaker who repeatedly shocks those around her with her mistakes, assumptions, and misunderstandings.

Forgetting to wear a skirt or answering the door naked are everyday occurrences for her, confusing Taichi in a different way than Fuuko does.

She begins to agree with Fuuko, who even tries to handle Taichi's sexual needs, and starts actively pursuing him.

[From [url=http://www.r18game.com/tougenkyo/lucky/chara.html]official site[/url]]
